classes.name: RusuiApplyAttempt
classes.description: Deterministic attempt keyed by stable action_id. v1 success is one intended-action record; GitHub-side outcome reconciliation is v2.

classes.name: RusuiApplyLane
classes.description: Deterministic server-side executor. Must not write pending snapshots. Item-hash mismatch or failed default-branch reachability: one txn cancel + optional evidence_invalidation + refresh_request. implemented_on_main requires merge commit ancestor of default-branch tip. v1 dry-run only.

classes.name: RusuiCompletionReceipt
classes.description: Accepted complete or fail result keyed by (job_id, lease_generation, claimed_revision). Lookup does not depend on current job state. Fail receipts have kind=fail and no review revision. Missing key stays rejected.

classes.name: RusuiControlPlane
classes.description: Self-hosted environment plane for coding agents: admits work onto sessions and turns, owns policy, leases, environments, credentials, and receipts, and is the only durable store.

classes.name: RusuiImplementLane
classes.description: ADR 0015 publication path. An implement session (a run session for an open pinned task on a repository with implement: true) holds the operator GitHub credential; the agent pushes and opens or updates its own pull request with git and gh. No plane proof gate. Merge, close, and land stay unauthorized; token scope and branch protection enforce that.

classes.name: RusuiEvidenceInvalidation
classes.description: Unique (review_revision_id, action_id) row inserted in the same transaction as apply cancellation and force refresh_request enqueue. Force admit consumes it once so recovery cannot increment pending_revision twice.

classes.name: RusuiIntendedAction
classes.description: v1 dry-run success record written once per action_id. Stores evidence class and the server-limit sentence (on-branch is not solved; item exists is not duplicate).

classes.name: RusuiJobLease
classes.description: Exclusive lease per repo, item, and lane. Admit while paused keeps state=leased if a worker is live. Claim rechecks repo still configured and review enabled. Unreceipted stale complete is rejected. operator_retry requeues failed jobs on an unchanged revision only.

classes.name: RusuiPolicyOverlay
classes.description: Durable SQLite overlay that may only narrow policy.yaml. Pause is global or per project and stops new claims, local Process starts, and apply. It does not kill an existing local Process. Overlay cannot add a session kind, egress class, or permission allow-rule. In-flight complete/fail still succeed. Pause does not reset failed jobs.

classes.name: RusuiPolicyRevision
classes.description: Immutable parsed snapshot of policy.yaml. Jobs bind to a revision; apply rechecks current policy immediately before action.

classes.name: RusuiProject
classes.description: Operator-named policy and budget domain. A session belongs to exactly one project; an environment belongs to exactly one; a GitHub repository binds to at most one. GitHub is optional; review requires a bound repository. Its optional Sumika project value is display grouping only, not a second identity or policy domain.

classes.name: RusuiEnvironment
classes.description: The machine a session runs on. One session, one Rusui Environment record. Managed environments are created from a snapshot, sleep after a configurable idle period, wake on the same handle before a follow-up turn, and expire after 72h idle; the experimental local profile identifies the operator's host and provides no isolation. P1 dogfood machine isolation is a container; the process driver and immortal local environment are not dogfood.

classes.name: RusuiEnvironmentReceipt
classes.description: Durable outcome record for an environment sleep or wake operation, including its state, time, and failure detail when present.

classes.name: RusuiSchedule
classes.description: Named project-owned trigger with a UTC cadence and a prompt. Each fire may start one scheduled session; skip if a session from this schedule is still running.

classes.name: RusuiSession
classes.description: Unit of work on one project and one environment. Review identity is (project, bound repo, item). run and scheduled identities are minted at create. A follow-up prompt is a new turn on the same session. The accepted experimental local kind is human-driven and has no Turn.

classes.name: RusuiTurn
classes.description: One lease-fenced attempt on an unattended Rusui Session. Local sessions have no Turn.

classes.name: RusuiUnattendedSession
classes.description: Rusui Session kind whose execution is mediated by leased Turns, including review, run, and scheduled work. The experimental local kind is excluded.

classes.name: RusuiLocalSession
classes.description: Accepted experimental human-driven Rusui Session kind with successive Process observation records and at most one active Sumika Process. It creates no Turn, lease, managed grant, model proxy credential, or GitHub credential and is not an OS isolation boundary.

classes.name: RusuiLocalRuntimeProfile
classes.description: Explicit per-project, default-off policy settings for one Sumika local runtime: exact argv and clean absolute cwd. Create requests cannot override them; the Process runs with the Sumika daemon's OS identity and receives no managed credential.

classes.name: RusuiSnapshot
classes.description: Prepared reusable tree identified by source_hash (base image digest, git pin, .agents/setup bytes). Cached on the runner. Two sessions may share a snapshot; they never share an environment.

classes.name: RusuiPerTurnGrant
classes.description: Only plane-brokered credential in a P1 guest outside implement sessions. 32-byte token, ten-minute TTL, hashed at rest, renewed on heartbeat. Redeems at plane git and model proxies. Not a GitHub token or xAI key.

classes.name: RusuiPublicContext
classes.description: Only approved public GitHub fields for a public-repo job. Private plan notes, Slack, other repos, and Aldunis are excluded. Publishable review fields are the only public write inputs.

classes.name: RusuiRefreshRequest
classes.description: Durable per-item work to fetch live GitHub state. One owner with refresh_generation and owner_expires_at. Fetch timeout 30s. Crashed or hung owners are expired on reaper/startup, backoff, max 5 retries. Late results with expired ownership are discarded. Apply enqueues these requests instead of calling admit.

classes.name: RusuiReconcileCheckpoint
classes.description: Durable (repo, last_processed_delivered_at, last_processed_delivery_id). Distinct from GitHub list-deliveries pagination cursor.

classes.name: RusuiReviewLane
classes.description: Claimed worker runs the Codex CLI adapter on server-built input.v1.json pinned to the claimed snapshot SHAs (main_sha from admit, not claim-time fetch) and reads output.v1.json. Model must not fetch live GitHub.

classes.name: RusuiReviewRevision
classes.description: Immutable canonical review JSON stored in SQLite with the completion receipt. Filesystem JSON/MD are optional exports. Identity and SHAs must match server-owned claim data. Model assertions are not server_verified evidence.

classes.name: RusuiStandingPlan
classes.description: Executable baseline is policy.yaml. Optional prose notes are not executable.

classes.name: RusuiWebhookReconciler
classes.description: Webhook ACKs delivery plus a refresh_request with no live fetch. Reconcile lists deliveries then fetches detail payloads; checkpoint advances only after detail plus refresh_request. Failed detail retries; after limit, skip only that delivery_id. Refresh coordinator is the only pending-snapshot writer.

classes.name: RusuiWorkerSandbox
classes.description: v1 trusted local execution as the same OS user. Env and cwd isolation are defense in depth, not a filesystem jail. Write tokens stay in the server. Filesystem and network jails are v2.

classes.name: RusuiSource
classes.description: Pinned intake identity (repo, item, snapshot_hash, main_sha) a candidate is proven against. Source drift invalidates proof.

classes.name: RusuiCandidate
classes.description: Git object (commit_sha, tree_sha, ref) on refs/heads/rusui/<session>/*. Not a working tree or default-branch tip.

classes.name: RusuiProof
classes.description: Isolated verifier output (command, exit_code, log_digest, head_sha, base_sha) for one candidate SHA. Independent review is a different session. Agent self-declaration is not proof.

classes.name: RusuiPublication
classes.description: Pull request the agent opens or updates itself from an implement session as the operator (ADR 0015). Commits carry Co-authored-by: rusui and Rusui-Session trailers. Human merge is required.

classes.name: SumikaProcess
classes.description: Live local PTY child owned by the Sumika daemon and named rusui-<Rusui session id>. Sumika calls it a Session. Sumika is authoritative for the process and local Attach; Rusui records its name and observed lifecycle events. Its optional project string is display grouping only. Rusui never stores its PTY bytes.

classes.name: RusuiProcessRecord
classes.description: Durable Rusui identity, generation-pinned argv/cwd fingerprint, latest observation, and optional cancellation intent for one Sumika process generation. Generation and revision fence stale reports; unknown after restart is not proof of death and blocks duplicate start. Cancellation starts with SIGTERM and escalates to SIGKILL after 30 seconds; it remains unconfirmed until Sumika reports dead. Sumika remains authoritative for the live child.

classes.name: RusuiAttachObservation
classes.description: Durable Rusui identity and status observation for one Sumika Attach generation. It contains no client token, socket, or PTY data; stale disconnects cannot end a newer generation. Sumika remains authoritative for the live connection.

classes.name: RusuiLocalAttach
classes.description: Ephemeral exclusive client connection to one Sumika Process. Sumika owns local Attach; a new Attach steals the prior one, while detach leaves the Process running.

relations.name: rusui_admits_review
relations.description: Control plane admits review jobs under current policy.

relations.name: rusui_binds_policy_revision
relations.description: Admitted jobs store a policy revision id.

relations.name: rusui_dispatches_apply
relations.description: Control plane dispatches deterministic apply attempts.

relations.name: rusui_finalizes_with_receipt
relations.description: Review finalization writes a completion receipt in the same transaction as publication.

relations.name: rusui_issues_lease
relations.description: Control plane issues exclusive job leases with generations.

relations.name: rusui_narrows_with_overlay
relations.description: Overlay pauses may only narrow the baseline policy revision.

relations.name: rusui_records_evidence_invalidation
relations.description: Apply records a unique evidence invalidation before force refresh.

relations.name: rusui_enqueues_refresh
relations.description: Control plane turns deliveries and catch-up into refresh_requests.

relations.name: rusui_reconciles_deliveries
relations.description: Control plane recovers missed or failed GitHub deliveries.

relations.name: rusui_review_produces_revision
relations.description: Review lane produces immutable review revisions.

relations.name: rusui_apply_references_revision
relations.description: Apply attempts reference an immutable review revision and action_id.

relations.name: rusui_records_intended_action
relations.description: v1 apply writes one intended-action record per action_id.

relations.name: rusui_stores_reconcile_checkpoint
relations.description: Control plane stores a durable delivery checkpoint separate from pagination cursors.

relations.name: rusui_sandboxes_model
relations.description: Review lane runs the model inside the worker sandbox.

relations.name: rusui_uses_public_context
relations.description: Public-repo review jobs receive only PublicContext.

relations.name: rusui_uses_standing_plan
relations.description: Control plane loads policy.yaml as the executable baseline.

relations.name: rusui_policy_names_project
relations.description: Policy v2 baseline names projects; a missing slug is out of scope.

relations.name: rusui_project_configures_local_runtime
relations.description: A project may explicitly configure one default-off local runtime profile when local sessions are enabled.

relations.name: rusui_session_belongs_to_project
relations.description: A session belongs to exactly one project.

relations.name: rusui_session_uses_environment
relations.description: A session runs on exactly one environment.

relations.name: rusui_schedule_belongs_to_project
relations.description: A named schedule is owned by one project.

relations.name: rusui_schedule_starts_session
relations.description: A schedule fire may start one scheduled session; overlapping live sessions skip.

relations.name: rusui_environment_from_snapshot
relations.description: An environment is created from a snapshot identified by source_hash. Two environments may share a snapshot.

relations.name: rusui_environment_holds_grant
relations.description: A P1 container environment holds only the current per-turn grant, never a GitHub or xAI secret.

relations.name: rusui_environment_records_receipt
relations.description: An environment records each sleep and wake outcome as a durable receipt.

relations.name: rusui_proof_judges_candidate
relations.description: An isolated proof is valid only for the candidate SHA and source snapshot it names.

relations.name: rusui_implement_session_publishes
relations.description: The agent in an implement session opens or updates its own pull request with the operator credential. Proofs are optional evidence, not a gate.

relations.name: rusui_local_session_has_process_record
relations.description: An experimental local Rusui Session retains successive Process generation records; at most one is active, and unknown remains active until reconciled.

relations.name: rusui_process_record_observes_sumika_process
relations.description: A Process record may refer to the Sumika child observed by its stable name; absence or an old observation does not assert current liveness.

relations.name: rusui_process_record_has_attach_observation
relations.description: A Process record retains Attach generation observations; at most one is currently observed attached, while history remains durable.

relations.name: rusui_attach_observation_identifies_sumika_attach
relations.description: An Attach observation may correspond to the Sumika-owned live client connection; Rusui does not own or proxy that connection.

relations.name: rusui_unattended_session_has_turn
relations.description: Unattended review, run, and scheduled sessions may have leased Turns. A local session has none.

relations.name: sumika_process_has_local_attach
relations.description: A Sumika Process has at most one current exclusive local Attach; a new Attach steals the previous one.

relations.name: rusui_project_groups_local_process
relations.description: Rusui may pass its Project name as Sumika's optional display grouping value for a local Process; the value grants no policy authority.
